analysis_depth: DEPTH_B (cut-delimited scenes + all CUT/BIG/ANIMATION and >=0.8%-area SMALL auto events reviewed on compact sheets; sub-0.8% changes such as caption words and thin strokes counted, not individually reviewed)

coverage.pass_A_narrative_structure: 34 scenes authored from full-duration 1 fps overview (69 frames) + event sheets
coverage.pass_B_automated: every native frame decoded; stage/caption/header band change detection; 47 stage events, 226 caption change frames
coverage.pass_C_fine_inspection: native-resolution sheets at every one of the 47 auto stage events (pre/active/post/hold frames); dense consecutive frames for the bag run cycle
coverage.pass_D_audio: whole soundtrack measured (RMS, pauses, spectrogram) + Whisper small.en; NOT auditory listening
coverage.pass_E_chronological: scene timeline contiguous over all 1804 frames; every stage-active frame attributed to an authored event; holds classified (no playback by agent)
coverage.frames_viewed_note: 1 fps overview 69 frames + event sheets; static holds between events are verified by zero stage change, not by viewing every frame

native_cadence.interpretation: no 5-frame duplicate cadence found; frames in motion change every frame (native cadence = 24 fps)

limitations: Direct audio listening not performed (agent has no auditory capability)
360x640 source: fine linework, text weight and sub-10-px motion are resolution limited
No independent second reviewer; confidence labels are single-reviewer
Motion method/tool is not observable from a final MP4
Unreviewed micro-changes below the 8-px stage threshold are treated as compression-noise level and not classified
